question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Maintain
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. '**Abandon**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the **meanings** of the given word and marked option:

 
 
• **Maintain- **to keep something in good condition.
 
• Abandon- to leave behind or run away from someone or something, or to give up something.
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the **meanings** of the other given options:
 
 
• **Protect- **to keep someone or something safe from injury, damage, or loss.
 
• **Preserve- **to keep something as it is, especially in order to prevent it from decaying or being damaged or destroyed.
 
• **Sustain- **to make or allow something to continue for a period of time.
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that ‘Maintain’ and ‘Abandon’ are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 3.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word 'Maintain':

 
• Synonyms: control, keep, manage, preserve, protect, conserve, retain.
 
• Antonyms: abandon, destroy, discontinue, finish, give up, ignore, neglect.
